outcome: Clinician opinions on standardizing myomectomy operation notes for comprehensive data input into a prospective database of pregnancy outcomes
cohort: 475 consultant obstetricians and gynaecologists across 25 hospitals in London, Kent, Surrey, and Sussex (UK)
finding: The majority of gynaecologists support standardizing myomectomy operation notes to facilitate the development of prospective large-scale databases of pregnancy outcomes after myomectomy.
